items.title: Lilli to Bring French/Mediterranean Flair to Las Vegas' Chinatown
items.blurb: French-Mediterranean spot Lilli opens permanently in Chinatown this summer after a residency at Durango Social Club.

items.title: Pasta & Pomo, Fresh Handmade Pasta Bar, to Open in Spring Valley
items.blurb: A handmade pasta concept from chef Massimo Zaretti, opening in the former Squeeze In space at Apache Plaza.

items.title: Dancing Dumplings, New Concept, Planned for Boca Park
items.blurb: Dancing Dumplings will open in Unit 15 of the Boca Park retail center.
